description: This source file contains utility functions and API client wrappers for user-related endpoints in a frontend project. It includes functions to fetch user data, projects, batch user projects, and session details from the backend API, along with a helper to format ISO date strings into MongoDB ISODate format.

methods.name: wrapIsoAsMongoISODate(iso)
methods.description: Wraps an ISO string into a Mongo-shell style ISODate("...") expression, used for endpoint query parameters that expect ISODate-wrapped timestamps.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a single user document by user ID from the /api/users/{id} endpoint.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Retrieves distinct projects for a user, optionally within a specified time range, ensuring dates are formatted correctly.

methods.name: getUsersProjectsBatch(body = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Fetches projects for multiple users in a single request via POST /api/users/projects, with optional time range filtering.

methods.name: getUserSessionDetails(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches aggregated session details for a user, such as total count and duration.
